newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets largely quiet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets largely quiet.

text.p: Millfeed supplies remained tight but demand from feed mixers was light as most were content to buy only for immediate needs, millfeed dealers said.

Dealers in several locations reported moderate increases in flour mill production and subsequently increased millfeed supplies. However, they said sharply higher wheat prices Thursday could have flour mills quickly scaling back production.
In southern areas pastures continued to improve, lessening the need for supplemental feeding.
A Chattanooga dealer said the higher wheat prices came just when flour mill production was rising there and more rail cars of millfeeds were available for sale.
"This advance in wheat could kill that," he said.

Wheat prices posted sharp gains at U.S. wheat futures exchanges in reaction to news the European Union would not subsidize additional wheat exports until July at least. The action was expected to increase demand from foreign buyers for U.S. wheat.
